plan: A chained mage who steals his enemies' ultimates and turns them against them.
aSurveiller: His R (Hijack). He steals your ultimate: if it's powerful, expect to see it come back against your team.
contrer: Watch which ultimate he steals (R): he can use it against you.
He heals with his W: buy a Grievous Wounds item.
Dodge his chain (E): it brings him onto you and knocks you up.
faiblesses: Has to be in melee range.
Relies on the ultimate he steals.

sorts.P: After a spell, his attacks hit in an area.
sorts.W: Leaps onto an enemy and heals.
sorts.E: Dash, then a chain that pulls him in and knocks up.

momentFort.jungle: Strong early, he ganks often from level 3. His R depends on the ultimate he can steal from the enemy team.
